# P0 Originate — synthetic intake

Move name: Member Service Agent Assist — Evidence-to-Estimate Smoke
Source: Synthetic planning scenario. Not a client attestation.

Business opportunity: Reduce avoidable agent effort and improve answer consistency by presenting relevant, current claims/authorization/eligibility context and approved knowledge during a live service interaction.

Initial solution hypothesis: Human-in-the-loop agent assist embedded in the existing contact-center desktop. Begin read-only; agent verifies before communicating.

Initial boundaries: No autonomous eligibility, claims, clinical, coverage, or prior-authorization decision. No production writeback in the first release. No savings commitment until Finance validates the baseline and capacity assumptions.

Initial change hypothesis: Limited changes to agent workflow and supervisor quality review; no assumed role reduction or operating-model redesign. Confirm or correct after P2 evidence.

Planning horizon: 90-day mobilization and pilot-readiness plan; execution occurs after the approved roadmap and outside Strategic Moves.

All values and roles in this package are synthetic.
